title: Industry unemployment bump chart
intent: Show how five U.S. industries changed rank by January unemployment from 2004 through 2010.

source.title: Observable Plot line mark and bump curve

ai.create: Create a bump chart from the industries dataset by selecting January observations, ranking unemployment within each year, drawing one curved line per industry, and directly labeling the final rank.
ai.maintain: Change the industry or year selection while retaining the original date, industry, and unemployed fields through the ranking transform, stable series colors, and labels at the newest observation.
